scenario: LUNI.8.7.1 / LUNI.8.2 — the negative case: a `::<unit>` cast carries its dimension into the downstream cross-dim check. `s.raw::kilogram` (mass) compared against `30_celsius` (temperature) crosses dimensions and rejects with DS_VALIDATE_DIM_MISMATCH.
rules_ds:
unit celsius: temperature = x + 273.15

schema Sensor scope logical:
    raw: Float key

rule bad:
    Sensor s where s.raw::kilogram > 30_celsius
->
    log info "never"
